questions: What is attachment?
When an attachment is removed, is it gone for good?
What is screening?
If screening is clear, are you completely in the clear?
What is validity?
If validity expires, is it worthless?
What is resilience?
If resilience is pushed to its limit, does everything return exactly as before?
What is feedback?
If feedback arrives late, is it useless?
What is extinction?
After an extinction, can it come back?
What is load?
If the load gets heavier, does performance always slow down?
What are norms?
If the norms change, does the score change too?
What is reliability?
If reliability is high, is the result necessarily right?
What is a trajectory?
If a trajectory is redirected, will it end somewhere different?
What is scaffolding?
When the scaffolding comes down, can it stand on its own?
What is transfer?
If the transfer goes through, does the original stay where it was?
What is an assessment?
If the assessment comes back high, is that always bad?
What is development?
When development is finished, is there nothing left to change?
What is fit?
If the fit is good, does it mean nothing needs changing?
